verses.1: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.2: What are you doing? You are governing this land of Israel, saying, “The fathers shall eat first, and then the sons will eat.”
verses.3: May the Lord, Jehovah, bless you. If there is still anyone who remains under this ruler in Israel.
verses.4: All those souls are like the soul of the Father and the soul of the Son to me. The soul that is guilty is death.
verses.5: And let there be a man who is righteous and who acts with fairness and justice.
verses.6: I did not eat in the mountains. I did not look towards the ruins of Israel’s houses. I did not even touch the fire of my enemy’s wife. I did not approach any woman who was divorced.
verses.7: And no man shall break his bondage. A thief shall not steal; he shall not take away what belongs to others. He shall give back what has been taken from him, and cover up his shame with his clothes.
verses.8: He will not give anything away; he will not take anything from others. He will sit down and judge fairly between people.
verses.9: In my laws, he will walk; and in my judgments, he will keep them. The righteous will live, yes, they will live. May the Lord God have mercy on them.
verses.10: And he had a son named Paritz, who shed blood and killed one of them.
verses.11: And he did not do all these things because he also ate from the fruits of the trees. He also ate the fruit of his enemy’s wife.
verses.12: The poor and the needy were destroyed by the thieves. The thief did not return, and he carried away those who were in need. His eyes were filled with hatred as he acted in such a cruel manner.
verses.13: In the valley, he gave and took away. But life will not endure all these sufferings. He caused death to come upon him; his blood will be the cause of his death.
verses.14: And behold, he begot a son. And he saw all the sins that his father had committed. But he refused to do those same things himself.
verses.15: He did not eat on the mountains, and his eyes did not look at the ruins of Israel’s houses. He did not even touch his enemy’s wife.
verses.16: And no man gave a gift without expecting something in return; he did not steal anything. He gave food to the hungry, and comfort to those who were distressed.
verses.17: From the grave, he raised his hand; it was cold and stiff. He did not take revenge against my judgments or laws. He went away, but he did not die in his father’s place. He will live on.
verses.18: His father, who was a wicked man, did evil deeds among his people. And now he has died in agony.
verses.19: And you said, “Know that the son shall not bear the burden of his father’s sins. The son shall do all that his father did, and he will keep all his commandments. He will live.”
verses.20: The wicked soul will perish; it will not be raised from the dead. The father will not be saved, and the son will not be saved either. The righteous will be blessed, while the wicked will be punished.
verses.21: And the wicked, even if they return from all their sins they have committed, and if they obey all my laws and do what is righteous and just, they will still live. They will not die.
verses.22: All his sins, which he committed, will not be remembered in his righteousness. But those actions he did will be remembered as part of his life.
verses.23: I desire that the wicked die. May the Lord of hosts have mercy on him when he returns from his wrongdoings and lives again.
verses.24: And once again, the righteous will do what is right, and they will do all those things that the wicked have done. They will live according to all their righteous deeds. But their good deeds will not be remembered, and their sins will lead to their death.
verses.25: And you said, “It is not possible to go through Adonai’s path.” Please listen, House of Israel! My path cannot be taken. Your paths also cannot be followed.
verses.26: Once again, he was righteous in his righteousness. But he also did evil. And he died because of his evil deeds.
verses.27: And once again, the wicked will be freed from their evil actions. They will do what is right and just. Then their souls will be saved.
verses.28: And he saw that he had repented from all his sins. Thus, he lived, and did not die.
verses.29: And they said, “The house of Israel cannot go along with my ways. Your ways do not lead to me; the house of Israel cannot follow them.”
verses.30: Therefore, each person will be judged according to his own ways. May the house of Israel be saved! May the Lord say, “Return and be restored from all your sins.” Then there will be no more trouble or suffering for you.
verses.31: Put away from yourselves all your sins, which you have committed. Give yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Then why do you remain in the house of Israel?
verses.32: For I do not desire the death of the dead. May Adonai Yehovah restore them to life!
